pages.text: $(l)Worn$(): you take $(l)8%%$() less melee damage.$(br2)$(l)Enshrined$(): allies within 48 blocks of the temple take $(l)15%%$() less melee damage. Allies are villagers, residents, iron golems, and your summoned units and tamed animals, but not you. Arrows, explosions and thorns are not melee.
After you defeat the $(l)Minotaur$(), the vault deep in the Labyrinth of Knossos opens for you, and the armor is inside. If you have not won, the vault stays shut; come back once you have.

Patroclus went into battle in Achilles' armor and was killed by Hector, who stripped the armor from him. Achilles' mother Thetis went to Hephaestus, and the smith god made Achilles a new shield, breastplate, helmet and greaves.$(br2)(Homer, Iliad, books 16 to 18)
